meta.title: Fold Minimal
meta.description: When the sidebar is collapsed, keeps a toolbar at the window's top-left — reopen / global panel icons in the same order as the sidebar menu / new session / back to session. v0.5 detects the DSH version: on the new release it follows the official pinned menu (pinned panels appear in the toolbar and sidebar; unpinned panels stay in the official More menu, and the plugin no longer keeps a second hidden state), while the old release keeps the plugin's own fold and More tray. The plugin page offers three independent switches — Collapsed menu / Back-to-session button / Panel reorder & fold. With reordering on, the expanded sidebar, collapsed toolbar, and More menu share one order, and rows inside More can be dragged to swap places.
